body_html: This was my FIRST HOMECOMING EVER…EVER!! If I had known they could be THIS MUCH FUN, I would have gone to my own growing up! Cameron was DEFINITLY IN HIS ELEMENT! The crowd reacted EVERYTIME HE PLAYED A SONG! Chris is a LIGHTING GENIUS! Together, they provided AN AWESOME NON-STOP PARTY! IT WAS LIKE BEING AT A CONCERT, the mix of LIGHTING and the JAMMIN MUSIC was AWE INSPIRING to say the least! I think what blew my mind the most was when Cameron played the last song of the night, JOURNEY’S “DON’T STOP BELIEVING”, and every single one of those young men and women sang along with the words! It made this old dog feel YOUNG AGAIN! Thank you Chris for showing me the lighting functions, thank you Cameron for letting me interact with the song choices, AND THANK YOU HORIZON HIGH, for letting me a part of this most MEMORABLE NIGHT!!!
